text: dsh-task-details 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端的任务详情侧栏插件。在每个已完成任务下方，客户端注册“查看任务详情”入口，打开可调整宽度的右侧面板。面板按任务展示输入与附件、任务读写的文件和中间产物、工具及 skill 调用、任务流程、语言与命令，以及模型提供方、名称和 token 用量。Host 端读取本机任务路径元数据、记忆文件与会话日志，浏览器端从会话事件整理任务记录。适合需要回看单次任务做过什么、用了哪些工具或消耗多少 token 的 DSH 用户；不需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-task-details adds a “View task details” entry beneath completed turns in the DeepSeek Harness web client. Its resizable sidebar summarizes task files, tool calls, workflow, and model token usage from session events and local metadata. No API key or external service is required.
想在每个 DSH 任务结束后快速查看它读写了哪些文件。
能不能把某次任务的工具调用和失败情况整理到侧栏里？
I want to review the files, tools, and token usage for a completed DSH task in one place.
dsh-task-details 的功能「单任务详情面板」：点击任务底部的“查看任务详情”入口，在右侧打开可调整宽度的标签页，集中查看该任务的文件、工具调用、流程和模型用量。
dsh-task-details 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 6 天；提交数 3；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-task-details README · 任务详情侧边栏（DSH 插件）：[English](./README.en.md) · 中文

在每个对话任务的最下方显示 **「查看任务详情」**，点开后从右侧边栏打开该任务的详情面板；面板宽度可以拖拽调整，拉宽后文件行会展开成完整明细（保存路径、日期、大小、行数、是否存在）。

一句话说明它解决什么：**任务跑完之后，你不需要往上翻聊天记录，就能看到这次任务到底读了什么、改了什么、用了哪些工具、烧了多少 token。**

text:
dsh-task-details README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-task-details
```

安装后**重启 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用**。重新打开任意历史任务，任务底部就会出现「查看任务详情」。

从源码安装（开发时）：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/zzt0818/dsh-task-details.git
dsh plugin add link:./dsh-task-details
```

dsh-task-details README · 开发：```sh
npm run build    # 把各模块内联成单一 client.js（浏览器端产物）
npm test         # 跑全部测试
```

`client.js` 是构建产物，由 `build.mjs` 生成，**不要手改**。

单独跑某一个测试：

```sh
node test/analyzer.test.mjs     # 分析器：会话日志按任务聚合
node test/fold.test.mjs         # 折叠：任务划分、无幻影任务、耗时
node test/host.test.mjs         # Host 聚合：文件存在性/大小/行数
node test/host-plugin.test.mjs  # Host 路由：405/400/200 与 dispose

dsh-task-details README · 结构：| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host 半：`POST /api/plugins/ui-task-details/describe` 与 `GET .../journal`，返回文件元数据、记忆文件、会话日志 |
| `analyzer.js` | 纯函数：把会话事件流按任务（Turn）折叠成输入/工具/用量/文件 |
| `model.js` | 地址格式、格式化、语言推断、可复用判断 |
| `details.js` | 面板视图（含拖拽调宽）与任务底部按钮 |
| `preference.js` | 面板宽度偏好（跨标签页共享） |
| `styles.js` | 样式（全部使用宿主 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题变量） |
| `copy.js` | 中英文案 |
| `icons.js` | 内联 SVG 图标（文件类型、skill、刷新、展开/折叠等） |
| `client-entry.js` | 浏览器端注册逻辑（槽位、标签页类型、样式、词典） |
| `client.js` | **构建产物**，由 `build.mjs` 生成 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle patch：插入 Host 插件行 |
| `icon.svg` / `locale/*.json` | 插件图标与显示元数据 |

dsh-task-details README · 设计要点：- **数据来源是会话日志**：面板直接读取 `sessions.binding(id).session.eventSource`，与 Chat 折叠无关，所以被折叠掉的工具调用也能看到；重新打开历史任务、断线重连后依然正确。
- **Host 只补浏览器看不到的信息**：文件是否仍存在、大小、修改时间、行数，以及 `.dsh` 下的记忆与日志位置。
- **宽度自适应**：默认 460px；≥560px 时文件行展开明细；≥700px 时面板内部变为双栏。宽度写入 `localStorage`，所有详情标签页共享。
- **跟随主题**：颜色全部取宿主 token，亮/暗模式自动适配；对公开 Theme 契约之外的旧别名提供兜底，缺 token 时自动回退到基础色，不会在某些 profile 下变成透明或黑块。
- **手动刷新与重试**：工具栏的刷新按钮立即重新拉取文件元数据（30 秒静默轮询之外）；读取日志失败时错误页提供「重试」按钮，会绕过缓存重新请求。
- **区块导航**：每个区块标题带数量徽标，可单独折叠；工具栏一键折叠/展开全部；点击顶部指标卡会滚动到对应区块、自动展开被折叠的目标并短暂高亮。
- **复制路径**：文件行的复制按钮写入的是文件真实路径（含 `navigator.clipboard` 不可用时的兜底），并带 1.5 秒「已复制」反馈。

dsh-task-details README · 已知边界：- 输入端只统计「工具读取过的文件」和消息附件；用户在系统里直接改的文件不会被记录，这是会话日志的固有边界。
- 面板只包含已加载的会话窗口；更早的任务需要先在 Chat 里向上翻页加载。
- 工具结果里的文件路径依赖 `<path>` 标记与 `file_path`/`path` 参数；纯命令行里 `>` 重定向生成的文件无法静态识别，会归入「未见路径」而不是伪造一条记录。
dsh-task-details README · 许可证：[MIT](./LICENSE)

dsh-task-details README · Task Details Sidebar (DSH plugin)：English · [中文](./README.md)

Every finished turn in Chat gets a **"View task details"** button. It opens that task's detail panel in the right sidebar; the panel width is draggable, and widening it expands each file row into full detail (saved path, date, size, line count, whether it still exists).

What it is for: **after a task ends, you should not have to scroll back through the transcript to see what it read, what it changed, which tools it used, and how many tokens it burned.**

dsh-task-details README · Task Details Sidebar (DSH plugin)：| Block | Implementation |
|---|---|
| The trigger | A button under each task (`conversation.chat.turnTail` slot) |
| Input files | Files this task read, plus the user's message text and attachment names |
| Intermediate artifacts | Files under temp/build/`.dsh` directories, `MEMORY.md` memory files, session logs (`.jsonl.zstd`) |
| Output files | Files this task wrote or delivered; each opens a preview |
| Tools / skills used | Call count, failure count, average duration; `skill` invocations listed separately |
| Languages and shells | Languages inferred from file extensions, shells executed, command count |
| Reusable? | A verdict based on delivered files, script output, skill use, and project changes |
| Task flow | A step-by-step timeline, one row per tool call, failures marked in red |
| Provider, model, usage, cache | Provider/model, input/output/cache-read/cache-write/reasoning tokens, cache hit rate with a progress bar |

dsh-task-details README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-task-details
```

Restart the DeepSeek Harness desktop app afterwards. Reopen any past task and the button appears at the bottom of it.

From a source checkout:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/zzt0818/dsh-task-details.git
dsh plugin add link:./dsh-task-details
```

dsh-task-details README · Development：```sh
npm run build    # inline the modules into the single browser artifact client.js
npm test         # run the whole suite
```

`client.js` is generated by `build.mjs`. Do not edit it by hand.

dsh-task-details README · Layout：| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host half: `POST /api/plugins/ui-task-details/describe` and `GET .../journal` |
| `analyzer.js` | Pure functions: fold the session event stream into per-task inputs, tools, usage and files |
| `model.js` | Address format, formatting, language inference, reuse verdict |
| `details.js` | The panel view (with drag-to-resize) and the turn-tail button |
| `preference.js` | Panel width preference, shared across tabs |
| `styles.js` | Styles, built entirely from the host's `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens |
| `copy.js` | Chinese and English strings |
| `icons.js` | Inline SVG icons (file types, skills, refresh, expand/collapse, etc.) |
| `client-entry.js` | Browser-side registration: slots, tab type, styles, dictionaries |
| `client.js` | **Build artifact** produced by `build.mjs` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch that inserts the Host plugin row |
| `icon.svg` / `locale/*.json` | Plugin icon and display metadata |

dsh-task-details README · Design notes：- **The session journal is the source of truth.** The panel reads `sessions.binding(id).session.eventSource` directly rather than the Chat transcript, so tool calls Chat folds away are still visible, and the panel stays correct after reopening a past task or reconnecting.
- **The Host half only adds what the browser cannot know**: whether a path still exists, its size, modification time and line count, plus where DSH keeps memory files and session logs under `.dsh`.
- **The layout responds to width**: 460px by default, file rows expand at ≥560px, and the panel becomes two columns at ≥700px. The width is stored in `localStorage` and shared by every details tab.
- **Theme-following**: every colour comes from a host token, so light and dark mode both work. Aliases outside the public Theme contract fall back to a base token, so a missing alias never turns a surface transparent or black.
- **Manual refresh and retry**: the toolbar refresh button re-reads file metadata immediately (on top of the quiet 30s poll); a journal read failure offers a Retry button that bypasses the cache.
- **Section navigation**: headings carry count badges and collapse in

dsh-task-details README · Known limits：- Inputs only count files a tool actually read, plus message attachments. Files you edit outside DSH are not recorded — that is an inherent limit of the session journal.
- The panel only covers the part of the session the Chat has loaded. Older tasks need the Chat scrolled up first.
- File paths in tool results come from `<path>` markers and `file_path`/`path` arguments. Files created by a `>` redirection in a plain command line cannot be identified statically; they are reported as "path not seen" rather than invented.
dsh-task-details README · License：[MIT](./LICENSE)

- **The Host half only adds what the browser cannot know**: whether a path still exists, its size, modification time and line count, plus where DSH keeps memory files and session logs under `.dsh`.
- **The layout responds to width**: 460px by default, file rows expand at ≥560px, and the panel becomes two columns at ≥700px. The width is stored in `localStorage` and shared by every details tab.
- **Theme-following**: every colour comes from a host token, so light and dark mode both work. Aliases outside the public Theme contract fall back to a base token, so a missing alias never turns a surface transparent or black.
- **Manual refresh and retry**: the toolbar refresh button re-reads file metadata immediately (on top of the quiet 30s poll); a journal read failure offers a Retry button that bypasses the cache.

dsh-task-details README · Known limits：- Inputs only count files a tool actually read, plus message attachments. Files you edit outside DSH are not recorded — that is an inherent limit of the session journal.
- The panel only covers the part of the session the Chat has loaded. Older tasks need the Chat scrolled up first.
- File paths in tool results come from `<path>` markers and `file_path`/`path` arguments. Files created by a `>` redirection in a plain command line cannot be identified statically; they are reported as "path not seen" rather than invented.
